rss.title: Fake Friend vs Real Friend: Who Falls With You? #shorts #viral #stickman
rss.description:
A green car, a mud puddle and two very different friends. One wipes your face clean and grins the second you look away. The other laughs so hard he slips and lands in the mud right next to you.

Then four more moments: the breakup, the dropped ice cream, the failed test and the rain. Watch who stays.

Send this to the friend who would laugh first and fall right next to you.
